description_en: Starts a cache purge or prefetch task after the file is uploaded successfully
description_zh: 刷新或者预热文件上传成功后，调用此接口启动刷新或者预热任务
name: SubmitUploadTask

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The file upload task ID, which is generated when you call the [UploadTask](~~UploadTask~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 文件上传任务ID，调用[UploadTask](~~UploadTask~~)接口时生成
parameters.name: upload_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to purge resources in the corresponding directory when the back-to-origin content is inconsistent with the origin server resources. Default value: false. This parameter is valid only for purge tasks.

true: Purges all resources in the corresponding directory.
false: Purges only the changed resources in the corresponding directory
parameters.help_zh:
当回源内容和源站资源对比后不一致时，是否刷新对应目录下的资源。默认为false。当为刷新任务时参数有效。
true：刷新对应目录下的全部资源。
false：刷新对应目录下发生变更的资源
parameters.name: force
